title: Require Domain Contract Aggregate Shape
forbids: domain aggregate contract files exposing constituent module contracts or any authority besides their singular default defineDomain result
why: A domain contract is one aggregate identity over direct semantic modules. Keeping constituent contracts private prevents callers from selecting partial or alternate contract authorities through the aggregate owner.
remediate: Import direct module contracts from ./modules/<module>/contract.js, compose one local defineDomain binding, and export only that binding as default.
message: Domain contract.ts must expose one default aggregate contract authority only.
